iOS:
Make room for focused work, and see where your time went.

Contadino is a focus timer and session log. Whether it’s a chapter to read, an idea to chase, or that project patiently waiting for you, choose a session length, press Start, and give one thing your attention.

Some sessions fly by. Others get interrupted. Keep working when you’re in the flow, or stop when you need to. Your history keeps a record of both, so you can look back at how your day unfolded.

A few words can make that record more useful. Add a note about where you left off or a tag for the project you were working on. The next time you return, you’ll have something to pick up from.

Choose a theme that feels comfortable, keep your timer in view with widgets and Live Activities, or check your session on Apple Watch. Your session history syncs through your iCloud account.
